verdict: Paid channels are dark; organic reach is softening across all three locations.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, no paid spend ran in the last 28 days — Meta and Google Ads are inactive at all three locations, meaning zero tracked leads came through paid channels this period. All measurable activity is coming from Google Business Profile, which logged a combined 381 actions (directions, calls, and web clicks) across the three locations, but that organic signal is weakening: GBP actions fell 61% at Forte Metals, 34% at Advance Grinding, and 15% at O'Hare Precision week-over-week. Organic search visibility at Forte Metals also compressed sharply, with Search Console clicks down 82% in the same window. We are prioritising the reactivation of paid campaigns to rebuild a trackable lead pipeline and addressing posting cadence to stabilise local search presence. Next period you should begin seeing paid activity resume and organic engagement stabilise as those actions take effect.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement is declining week-over-week at all three locations, and organic search clicks at Forte Metals are down sharply — the only active pipeline is shrinking.
watch_item.fix: Posting cadence is being increased to stabilise local visibility, and paid campaign reactivation is in motion to reduce dependence on organic alone.
